messages:
Paula H: Heads-up — kicking off a quick least-privilege pass on KMS admin roles next week. Goal: prune stale keys, remove unused admin principals, and tighten role scopes. Tagging folks who touched KMS recently.

Kevin L: Thanks. Can we get the current list of principals with Admin / kms:*? Any chance audit-bot can dump that to a CSV?

audit-bot: Automated report attached — found 23 principals with high KMS privileges; 7 principals have zero key usage in the last 90d. Notable: several infra service accounts, 2 human users (Jordan M, Anya S) flagged for recent interactive activity.

Anya S: That's probably from the infra migration last year. I can own validation for the service accounts and confirm which need perms.

Jordan M: I still need access for one deploy flow (infra-deploy-kms). I'll add justification in the PR. What rollback plan do we have if we accidentally prune a key or role used by production?

Paula H: We'll gate all changes behind a canary rollout and smoke tests. Ops will have automatic remediation hooks. High level plan: 1) create PR listing removals + justification; 2) run canary prune in non-prod; 3) run smoke test suite and deploy checks; 4) promote to prod if clean. If checks fail, ops-bot will re-add perms and alert on-call within 30m.

Kevin L: Also: export audit logs for the last 180 days to the secure bucket for compliance review. Please tag the export with retention=kms-review-2026.

Paula H: Good call. I'll create the bucket and lifecycle rule. We also need to update the runbook: sec/kms-privilege-prune. Who can take runbook + playbook edits?

Anya S: I can update the runbook and add the exact queries and criteria we used. Example queries I'll include: ```aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[]' --output json``` and an example IAM lookup: ```aws iam list-roles --query "Roles[?contains(RoleName, 'kms')]|[?RoleName!='']"``` plus notes on last_used timestamps.

Jordan M: Adding my PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/892 — contains the deploy justification and a test plan. :thumbsup:

Paula H: Timeline: start the pruning job Monday (planned start 1764620000 UTC). Weekly checkpoints and final report due Friday of the same week. @audit-bot please schedule weekly digests and include the unused-principals CSV.

audit-bot: Scheduled weekly digest created; next run 1764660000 UTC. I'll attach CSVs and counts to the digest. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Reminder — before any prod change, create a canary environment snapshot and tag affected keys with label "kms-prune-2026" for easy rollback.

Paula H: Perfect. I'll open the tracker ticket and mark owners for each flagged principal. Thanks everyone — short sync Tues EOD to confirm runbook and PRs.
